Role / persona, organisation type, geography (country; state if India)
How many of InvokED 1.0–5.0 the respondent attended
Pre-filled from the registrant record, or the post-close tap
Magnitude (no change / somewhat / significantly) and the belief or idea that changed — or, for non-shifters, what would have made a difference
Initiated? (Yes / In progress / No) · partner org or person · type (co-creation / pilot / knowledge exchange / funding / advisory) · description and outcome, or expected outcome
Was the partner someone met at InvokED, someone already known, or a mix
What the respondent still wants to take forward · what is blocking it · anyone from InvokED they remain in touch with
Level (not at all / moderately / significantly) and what specifically changed
Would return? (yes / maybe / no) · what would make year-round engagement worth their time · named connections
Q5, plus named partners from Q3
How the respondent defines 'future readiness' in their own work, and what they are doing to advance it
Willing to share (written / video)? · Awards: nominate or be considered? · best contact to follow up
One sentence suitable for narrative, social or report use
Photo of a collaboration, pilot or InvokED moment, if uploaded
B. AGGREGATE IMPACT REPORT (feeds the InvokED Impact Report / photobook)
# collaborations initiated · # in progress · # pilots launched · # cross-sector partnerships · # geographies · % repeat participants
Of all reported collaborations, the split between partners met at InvokED and partners already known
InvokED action stories (case studies) · feedback quotes and videos · transformation journeys
Q3 probes 1 and 3 · Q2 probe · post-close consent
How senior education leaders define future readiness, the range of definitions, and what they are doing about it
Latent collaborations that never happened, and the barriers that stopped them
Cut all metrics by persona, geography, and edition attended
High-value connectors · active collaborators · potential forum leaders
Perception gaps and corrective measures · the year-round engagement offer
C. METHODOLOGY NOTES (to be published with the report)
The survey does not measure a before/after change. It records what respondents say shifted. State this rather than implying a measured delta.
No single question is asked of every respondent about staying connected, so report named connections rather than a percentage.
~800–1,000 invited; 150–250 completions expected. Respondents who collaborated are likelier to reply, so collaboration rates skew high.
Future-readiness findings represent 150–250 senior education leaders. They are not a sector-wide or population-level view.
